description: Labelled retrieval evaluation set (v3). expected_sources lists every policy document that genuinely answers the question; several facts are deliberately repeated across documents. must_contain is an evidence-level check: a retrieved chunk only counts if it contains every listed string (a nested list means any one of the alternatives). Labels were checked against the raw source documents. kind tags the question: prose (answer in running text), table (answer in a table row), paraphrase (natural wording that does not echo the section heading), aggregate (answer spans several table rows). v3 adds evidence labels (must_contain) to every question and q37–q50, including six questions answered by the public FTC regulation (16 CFR Part 435).
synthetic: mixed: questions are hand-written; q37–q42 target a public source
